capability.summary: Search tracked working-tree files for line-leading Git conflict-marker text and return at most 200 matching lines
capability.description: Runs a fixed `git grep -nE` pattern for lines beginning with seven `<`, `=`, or `>` marker characters. It reports matching file names and a full match count, truncates marker details to 200 lines, and never resolves or edits conflicts.
capability.problem_space: Heuristic read-only search for unresolved-looking marker text in tracked working-tree files; not Git index conflict-stage detection, merge-state validation, conflict resolution, or repository mutation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing repository path; output: JSON with unique matching files, total marker-line count, and at most the first 200 raw git-grep lines.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory whose tracked working-tree files should be searched
constraint.output_shape: After any completed Git process: {status: "success", tool: "git", target: string, conflicted_files: string[], conflict_marker_count: integer, markers: string[]}; conflicted_files and count use every nonblank stdout line, while markers is truncated to lines[:200]. The Git exit code and stderr are omitted, so grep exit 1 (no matches) and hard Git failures can both appear as success with empty arrays. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. Missing Git, 120-second timeout, and other subprocess exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback.
limitations: detects only tracked-file lines beginning exactly with `<<<<<<<`, `=======`, or `>>>>>>>`; indented markers and nontracked files are missed, while legitimate matching text can be a false positive
does not inspect unmerged index stages via `git diff --diff-filter=U` or verify that the repository is in a merge/rebase conflict state
ignores Git's return code and stderr, so repository or command failures can be indistinguishable from a clean scan
returns at most 200 marker detail lines although counts/files use all stdout, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and never edits or resolves files

output_contract.description: JSON heuristic marker scan with all matching files, total line count, and at most 200 raw grep lines; Git failures are not distinguished from no matches.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: scan tracked Git files for unresolved conflict marker text
list files containing line-leading merge marker patterns
negative_intents: reliably inspect Git unmerged index stages or merge state
scan untracked files or arbitrary non-Git directories
